source: GtRNAdb (UCSC Lowe Lab), Arabidopsis thaliana tRNA gene set
build: tRNAscan-SE predicted nuclear tRNA gene set from araTha1-tRNAs.fa (GtRNAdb genome dir /genomes/eukaryota/Athal10/); genes counted per anticodon (initiator iMet + elongator Met merged at CAT). No SeC/Undet/Sup/pseudogene entries are present in this file, so none were excluded. Anticodon read from the name field after the amino acid and verified against the parenthetical (ANTICODON) on every record (0 mismatches). Independently re-counted from a sha256-pinned FASTA via a second parse path with zero mismatches.
genome: TAIR10 (GtRNAdb assembly araTha1; nuclear only; no mitochondrial/plastid tRNAs)
note: Real tRNA gene copy numbers by anticodon for eukaryote Arabidopsis thaliana (sking=0). tAI relative adaptiveness is derived via the dos Reis et al. (2004) wobble model (optimised s-values) as in the tai R package; see bt4.biomodels.codon.tai. Reproducible from this file's SHA-256. HONESTY CAVEAT: araTha1 is an older GtRNAdb genome build (TAIR10) whose per-genome -tRNAs.fa is the raw tRNAscan-SE predicted set; GtRNAdb ships no separate high-confidence filtered FASTA for this assembly (confidence-set/detailed.out returned HTTP 404). Some anticodon counts are unusually high for a plant genome (e.g. Tyr-GTA=61, Pro-TGG=43, Ser-AGA=35), a known feature of tRNA-derived repeat elements in Arabidopsis and of this older prediction; counts are reported faithfully, not filtered. Source FASTA: https://gtrnadb.ucsc.edu/genomes/eukaryota/Athal10/araTha1-tRNAs.fa (115800 bytes, sha256 bd3ec0eba41382da71ab14e804d1f5a1a6ac42848f317486fd590118823e6c37). Source database: GtRNAdb (Chan & Lowe, Nucleic Acids Res 2016, doi:10.1093/nar/gkv1309), predictions by tRNAscan-SE 2.0 (Chan et al. 2021, doi:10.1093/nar/gkab688). GtRNAdb states no explicit data license: citation-gated academic use, NOT a CC/public-domain grant.
